decision.observation: 3 mph, gear 1, all dots dark, no red X. The car is rolling again on the grass right of the lane. The tarmac, marked by white posts, runs up the left of frame past the bale piles and the truck toward the blue puddles.
decision.hypothesis: The car is free and rolling with the lane only a few car widths to its left. A throttle-left hold should angle it across the verge and onto the tarmac before the barrels and truck.
decision.memory: This is the recurring overshoot spot: the car ends on the outside-right grass of the left bend and must be steered left, not straight, to rejoin.
